title: Size of a quarter-radius Hamming ball
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every binary word $a$ of length $n$, the Hamming ball centred at $a$ with radius $\lfloor n/4\rfloor$ has cardinality at most $2\binom{n}{\lfloor n/4\rfloor}$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a binary word of length $n$
replaced:
For every $n$ and every centre $a \in \{0,1\}^n$, the Hamming ball of radius
$\lfloor n/4 \rfloor$ around $a$ satisfies
\[
  \abs{B_{\lfloor n/4 \rfloor}(a)} \le 2 \binom{n}{\lfloor n/4 \rfloor}
\]
(as real numbers).
